about: Pressurant bottles Hardware mode may offer in place of the drawn one. Seeded only with the bottle the shipped drawings carry; no vendor data sheet is in this repo. Add a row per bottle you can buy (volume, service pressure, mass) with its data sheet in 'provenance'. The flight's mass comes from the config's press_tank block, which a bottle row does not change: a heavier bottle needs that block updated too. A user's own rows live in <userdata>/layerx/catalog/bottles.json.

rows.label: 45 scf SCBA cylinder (as drawn)
rows.provenance: Drawings copv_study_he / copv_study_gn2 / ethalox_stand: KB1. Volume 4.6871 L 'measured' (45 scf SCBA: 52.8 mol std air, Z 1.115 at 4500 psi, plus fittings); service pressure 4500 psi 'manufacturer' (He/GN2 drawings); wall mass 3.5 kg and MAWP 6750 psi 'estimated'.
